fluff.overview: The Capellan Confederation has always relied on its infantry to compensate for the CCAF's chronic shortage of heavier assets. Conventional foot soldiers, drawn from the citizens' militia system that defines Capellan military service, form the backbone of garrison forces across the Confederation's commonalities. Jump-capable infantry give CCAF commanders a vertical mobility option for urban combat and rough terrain operations. The added cost of jump equipment limits their numbers compared to foot formations, but their ability to bypass obstacles and reach elevated positions makes them valuable in the defensive fighting the Confederation often faces. Equipped with laser rifles that offer superior range and armor penetration compared to ballistic weapons, these platoons field one of the most effective personal arms available to conventional infantry, though the weapons are significantly more expensive and require soldiers to carry additional power packs.
